narrative.headline: 2020 Subaru Forester: windshield and visibility complaints lead by far
narrative.summary: Owners filed 590 complaints with NHTSA. Visibility-related issues dominate: Visibility/Wiper is the top area at 43%, and a separate Visibility category adds another 8%, so roughly half of all reports touch on the glass and seeing out of the car. The electrical system (16%) and engine (12%) follow. No deaths are reported. The smallest area by report count, Forward Collision Avoidance (7%), has the most injuries of any area (7) and 4 crashes, so it is worth a close look on a test drive.
